module: Editor window "Undo History": shows side by side the undo stack (editor.history.undoStack) and the redo stack (redoStack). Each action is listed with its name; a tooltip shows a truncated dump of the action (20 lines of 100 characters max). Buttons "Undo Selected", "Redo Selected" (call editor.undo / editor.redo with the number of steps) and "Delete All History" (editor.clearUndoHistory, without undoing the changes).
notes: The window is called "undoHistory" and is opened via the menu Window > Undo History.
The selected indices (selectedIndex, selectedIndex2) are local variables of the module, not exported.

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every editor frame: draws the Undo History window with the two stacks.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: adds the "Undo History" menu entry and registers the window (initial size 300x500).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads; does nothing.
